title: Heat Resilience in Sight — eight-city application
role: eight-city application, not a validation of VATA, UTCI, or SHR
license: derived research tables; raw street-view imagery not redistributed
citation: Yang, S. et al. Heat Resilience in Sight: Climate-Conditioned Thermal Affordance of Streetscapes Across Cities and Seasons. Workshop draft. https://github.com/Sijie-Yang/Heat-Resilience-In-Sight
singapore_note: HRIS Singapore is the 21,772-image panel. It is not the TCIS 92,233 survey set.

anchor.note: Normative planning benchmark, not a physiological threshold.

climate: Open-Meteo archive ERA5-Land hourly 2015-2024 city centroid; 10-17 local; SolarCal open-sun MRT
climate_note: Hourly climatological proxy, not a street-canyon simulation.

quantities.VATA: visual thermal affordance supply (0-5); not measured comfort and not UTCI
quantities.UTCI: physical heat-stress index from the climatological proxy
quantities.SHR: city-mean VATA minus climate-adjusted VATA need; not UTCI and not VATA
